The binding statement text never defines p_B: that p_B is the probability, conditioned on the input being Bell state B, of the detection pattern being mapped to B exists only in the evidence file's 'setting' field ('p_B = sum over patterns mapped to B of Pr[pattern | B]'). The statement also never says the input ranges over the four Bell states; 'acting on the dual-rail Bell pair' (singular) leaves the conditioning implicit, despite the note 'statement made self-contained after review round 1'. [Statement phrase 'the average success (1/4) sum_B p_B' vs k1_m5_p_avg_bound.json 'setting' field]

The dual-rail encoding convention (phi+- = (|1,0,1,0> +- |0,1,0,1>)/sqrt2, 'mode 1 (qubit A) and mode 3 (qubit B) carrying |0>') appears only in the evidence 'setting' field, not in the statement text the receipt binds to. Immaterial to truth because the quantifier over all U in U(5) absorbs rail relabelings, but the exact-text binding does not carry the encoding. [k1_m5_p_avg_bound.json 'setting': 'Bell states in Fock occupations of modes 1-4...' vs statement 'dual-rail Bell pair (qubit A on modes 1-2, qubit B on modes 3-4)']

The record is ambiguous about exactly which identity set was replayed. [k1_m5_p_avg_bound.json about.machine_checked item (b) vs evidence entry 2 note detail '{"bound": "2/3", "detail": "80 identities; bound 2/3"}']

The identification of bell_amp_poly's permanent polynomials with the physical detection amplitudes (so that |A_B(n)|^2 = Pr[pattern|B], which W5 consumes) is neither among the machine_checked items nor a written step W1-W6; its stated support, 'cross-validated against both float engines by tests/test_p3_poly_k1.py', is an artifact outside the evidence file and outside the certified replay boundary. Partially mitigated in-boundary: summing the checked identities (I1)+(I2) over i at U^dag U = I forces sum_n |A_B(n)|^2 = 1, pinning overall normalization. [about.machine_checked (b) parenthetical '(cross-validated against both float engines by tests/test_p3_poly_k1.py)' and 'setting' field definition of p_B]
